description:
About the job

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll drive the team forward, guiding them over every obstacle and leading the way to develop exciting, original and effective solutions. Leading the way, you’ll bring our team together to build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

About The Team

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits many customers around the world. Marketing Technology (MarTech) team's mission is to develop systems and tools that enable marketers to provide customers multi-touch, personalized and timely messages that enhance the experience of using our services. Customer journey automation and real-time targeting are examples of systems that the team works on. These systems are built using cutting edge technologies and products from AWS like Kinesis, S3, EMR, Elastic Search, etc.

About You

You’re in your element when you’re being challenged, and you’re always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility and keep developing at an exciting pace. We look for people who show initiative, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive and help your team reach their potential. With opportunities to challenge yourself and lead a talented team to success, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, you will...


 Lead complex technical initiatives within your team
 Mentor and support other developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding
 Explore technical needs and bring solutions to the table
 Establish and follow good engineering practices
 Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

A day in the life

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years experience of software development and deployment of distributed multi-tier applications
 Experience taking a lead role delivering complex software systems to internal or external customers
 Prior use of AWS technologies at scale in a production environment
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in the Advertising Technology domain, such as building integrations and pipelines with major media players (Meta, Google, etc.), implementing market leading MarTech and AdTech platforms: CRM, CDP, DMP, DSP, Ad Server, Programmatic buying, Search bidding and buying, Programmatic, Attribution, etc.
 Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous situations
 History of delivering customer-driven software products at a high scale in a fast paced, technology first, rapid-growth company
 Competency at delegating work in parallel to accelerate delivery
 Enthusiasm for promoting high-quality standard in others across: documentation, unit testing, code reviews, test automation, continuous integration and deployment

About the job

Atención: Esta es una asociación basada 100% en rendimiento (revenue share). NO es un puesto con sueldo fijo ni un contrato de empleo tradicional.




Si generas tráfico, compras pauta publicitaria o construyes audiencias, ya sabes por qué fallan los programas de afiliados SaaS tradicionales: las cookies de 30 días caducan. Envías un prospecto de alta calidad, compra su suscripción 40 días después y tú pierdes la comisión.

title: Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
About the job

Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

This role is essential to ensuring paid media campaigns are executed with precision and continuously improved through data-driven insights. By managing day-to-day campaign operations, supporting agency collaboration, and monitoring performance, the Advertising Specialist helps maintain campaign efficiency, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute to overall demand generation success.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop paid media strategy and audience approach.

Research advertising trends and platform best practices to enhance strategic media planning.

Support creative development for paid media assets by developing creative briefs, reviewing assets, and ensuring creatives align with our brand guidelines.

Build and segment ideal customer profiles on paid media channels using platform targeting and audience lists.

Own the end-to-end tracking of new media launches from campaign development to execution.

Collaborate closely with Corporate, regional marketing and content teams to align on paid messaging roadmaps for new campaign launches.

Support ad copywriting development as needed.

Develop testing roadmaps and prioritize based on business goals and seasonality.

Campaign Execution & Management

Collaborate with website and media technology team to ensure accurate implementation of campaign tracking, tagging, and URL taxonomy for consistent attribution and measurement.

Ensure campaigns are trafficked accurately, including ad set-up, audience targeting, creative uploads, and tracking implementation.

Partner with media agency to ensure timely and organized campaign launches.

Lead weekly campaign status meetings with agency partners to review campaign updates, optimizations, and opportunities.

Monitor media spends pacing and invoicing/reconciliation against planned budgets.

Oversee campaign launches, documenting and communicating changes and updates to stakeholders.

Conduct pre and post launch QA to validate campaign set-up.

Drive operational excellence by enhancing processes, establishing clear timelines, and accountability with agency partners.

Manage multiple campaigns and priorities, ensuring work is organized, tracked, and timely.

Campaign Measurement

Monitor and analyze channel KPIs and performance trends, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

Maintain accurate documentation of key results to inform future campaign planning and execution.

Own development and maintenance of weekly and monthly paid media reporting.

Partner with media agency to leverage insights to optimize campaigns and scale performance.

Ensure measurement accuracy, validating data across reporting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, or campaign execution, with hands-on responsibility for campaign launches and optimization.

Proven experience executing campaigns across search, social, and programmatic channels (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, DV360 or similar platforms).

Strong working knowledge of campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes, including experience with tracking frameworks (e.g., UTM parameters, pixels, conversion tracking).

Experience collaborating with media agencies and cross-functional teams (demand generation, brand, web, analytics), with the ability to manage deliverables and timelines effectively.

Experience in campaign performance analysis and reporting, with the ability to interpret KPIs and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion performance (MQL → SQL → revenue), with an ability to identify optimization opportunities.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and execution.

Advanced English is required

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Descrição Do Cargo

This role is essential to ensuring paid media campaigns are executed with precision and continuously improved through data-driven insights. By managing day-to-day campaign operations, supporting agency collaboration, and monitoring performance, the Advertising Specialist helps maintain campaign efficiency, identify opportunities for optimization, and contribute to overall demand generation success.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning

Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, sales, and product teams to develop paid media strategy and audience approach.

Research advertising trends and platform best practices to enhance strategic media planning.

Support creative development for paid media assets by developing creative briefs, reviewing assets, and ensuring creatives align with our brand guidelines.

Build and segment ideal customer profiles on paid media channels using platform targeting and audience lists.

Own the end-to-end tracking of new media launches from campaign development to execution.

Collaborate closely with Corporate, regional marketing and content teams to align on paid messaging roadmaps for new campaign launches.

Support ad copywriting development as needed.

Develop testing roadmaps and prioritize based on business goals and seasonality.

Campaign Execution & Management

Collaborate with website and media technology team to ensure accurate implementation of campaign tracking, tagging, and URL taxonomy for consistent attribution and measurement.

Ensure campaigns are trafficked accurately, including ad set-up, audience targeting, creative uploads, and tracking implementation.

Partner with media agency to ensure timely and organized campaign launches.

Lead weekly campaign status meetings with agency partners to review campaign updates, optimizations, and opportunities.

Monitor media spends pacing and invoicing/reconciliation against planned budgets.

Oversee campaign launches, documenting and communicating changes and updates to stakeholders.

Conduct pre and post launch QA to validate campaign set-up.

Drive operational excellence by enhancing processes, establishing clear timelines, and accountability with agency partners.

Manage multiple campaigns and priorities, ensuring work is organized, tracked, and timely.

Campaign Measurement

Monitor and analyze channel KPIs and performance trends, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations.

Maintain accurate documentation of key results to inform future campaign planning and execution.

Own development and maintenance of weekly and monthly paid media reporting.

Partner with media agency to leverage insights to optimize campaigns and scale performance.

Ensure measurement accuracy, validating data across reporting platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

2–4 years of experience in paid media, digital marketing, or campaign execution, with hands-on responsibility for campaign launches and optimization.

Proven experience executing campaigns across search, social, and programmatic channels (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, DV360 or similar platforms).

Strong working knowledge of campaign trafficking, tagging, and QA processes, including experience with tracking frameworks (e.g., UTM parameters, pixels, conversion tracking).

Experience collaborating with media agencies and cross-functional teams (demand generation, brand, web, analytics), with the ability to manage deliverables and timelines effectively.

Experience in campaign performance analysis and reporting, with the ability to interpret KPIs and translate data into actionable insights.

Strong understanding of funnel metrics and conversion performance (MQL → SQL → revenue), with an ability to identify optimization opportunities.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and execution.

Advanced English is required

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support


Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.


Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support


Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.


Payment Workflow Analysis


Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.


Documentation & Process Tracking


Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.


Agile Meetings


Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.


What We Look For:


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

description:
About the job

About The Team

As a Senior Software Development Engineer (iOS) on the 3D Home Capture team, you'll join a collaborative group dedicated to empowering photographers to efficiently capture, manage, and deliver the high-quality media assets and data that power Zillow's 3D tours, floor plans, and SkyTours. This team makes Zillow's listings more interactive and visually engaging, directly supporting Zillow's mission to redefine the home shopping journey and help users make confident decisions.

Home Capture is a cross-platform team inventing new ways to capture dense data. How do you accurately map an entire home using only the device in your pocket? Our technology now generates dimensionally accurate, interactive floor plans from phone sensors alone. Producing them is hard; producing them at scale is a separate problem. We work with partner teams across imaging pipelines, machine learning, computer vision, and low-level phone sensor data such as LiDAR, and we integrate data from 360 cameras and drones.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer (iOS), you'll own features end to end on the app photographers use in the field every day. You'll design and ship components of the capture experience, partner with backend, Android, design, product, and ML engineers to deliver a coherent product, and contribute to the architectural decisions that shape how the app scales. Your work reaches the listings that millions of home shoppers browse.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


BS/MS in Computer Science, or equivalent experience, and 4+ years of professional software development experience
3+ years of iOS development experience, including the release process
Strong Swift and SwiftUI skills
Ability to design and implement testable, maintainable mobile code
Experience with performance profiling and optimization
Experience collaborating across disciplines (backend, Android, web, design, product, ML) to deliver cohesive product experiences
A record of delivering high-quality code on schedule
Experience in Agile development environments
Clear written and spoken communication
Willingness to learn and grow
Fluent in English and Spanish, written and spoken
Authorized to work in Mexico


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Pricing Analyst and Market Planning & Operations
description:
About the job

Role: Associate, Market Planning & Operations (MP&O) – LATAM Pricing & Yield

Location: São Paulo, Brazil , Mexico

Scope: LATAM – Brazil, Mexico & other LATAM markets

Hiring Manager: Matias Apartin, Sr. Manager, MP&O (LATAM – Pricing & Yield)

The role focuses on supporting LATAM Ads Sales through commercial pricing, yield management, deal support, pricing operations, rate cards, NPP, SVA, forecasting, reporting, and cross-functional business analysis.

The ideal profile has experience in pricing/revenue management, advertising or media operations, sales operations, ad tech/programmatic, and strong Excel/Google Sheets/Tableau skills. Portuguese and English are required, with Spanish being a plus.

If this opportunity aligns with your background and interests, I’d be happy to share the complete job details and discuss next steps.




Associate, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil — LATAM role (Brazil, Mexico, and other LATAM markets)

Hiring Manager: Matias Apartin, Sr. Manager, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield)

Researcher and Recruiter: TBD




Context on Position

Netflix is seeking to hire an Associate, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield) based in São Paulo to

support Ads Sales across LATAM, including Brazil, Mexico, and other markets.

This person supports LATAM commercial pricing and runs day-to-day pricing and yield

operations: inquiries, deal support, rate cards, deal tracking, approvals, system records,

reconciliations, analysis, and reporting. The work keeps Sales moving quickly while keeping

pricing, NPP, SVA (Service Value Added), and agency terms accurate across files and systems.

The role reports to Matias Apartin and works closely with LATAM Ads Sales, the Manager of

Pricing & Incentives, Sales Operations, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Measurement, Legal,

Product, and regional / global MP&O partners.




Activities include

Commercial support and analysis

● Support LATAM commercial pricing for agency and brand development

● Answer day-to-day pricing inquiries, ad hoc pricing requests, and deal-negotiation

support across LATAM

● Support deal approvals and business exceptions so pricing and deal terms follow policy

● Analyze business drivers, yield KPIs, eCPM vs floors, cash vs SVA, and incentive

utilization

● Build templates, NPP calculators / models, and dashboards for pricing, forecasting, and

inventory

● Generate supply and demand reporting and support ad hoc requests

● Support Upfronts, NPP accelerators, custom deals, and agreed floors / bands

● Create stakeholder decks and training on pricing tools and policy

Pricing operations

● Update LATAM rate card spreadsheets, keep links and tabs current, reconcile local CPM

tables against the global open rate card, and surface changes for visibility

● Maintain package files, including CPM rows, package details, SVA references, and

Sales-facing source links




● Update package trackers for market moments such as World Cup, Mother's Day,

Halloween, and other commercial windows, reflecting CPM discounts, SVA, and STS

components

● Update STS simulator files, validate title / slot inputs, maintain pricing-condition rows for

NAS, and coordinate when STS assumptions need visibility

● Maintain live-event pricing files, update event-specific slot and package tiers, review files

before Sales use, and keep source links current

Approvals and exceptions

● Review incoming SVA / AV requests against current guardrails, update the AV tracker,

and keep usage reporting ready for quarterly review

● Review makegood requests, check supporting delivery context, update the makegood

tracker, and document outcomes for reconciliation

● Log pro bono requests, track approvals, and include approved activity in the right

reporting file

● Update the exceptions tracker for requests outside standard rules, including AV usage

windows, minimum AV share, and makegood-related exceptions

● Review Ad Connect / NAS queues, update approval status, flag items that need

additional input, and document the outcome so Sales has a clear answer

● Keep approval guardrail documents current so recurring requests are handled

consistently

NPP and annual deal operations

● Run NPP quarterly reconciliation: pull NPP, AV, Salesforce, NAS / Ad Connect, and

deal-tracker inputs; reconcile the numbers; update working files; and share the output

● Run NPP end-of-year reconciliation: review annual quota status, identify retroactive

payment implications, update the tracker, and circulate numbers for alignment

● Update the deal tracker with negotiation status, committed amounts, benefits offered,

pricing conditions, and client-specific terms

● Maintain the agency deal tracker, update pacing / benefit status, and keep

rebate-relevant fields ready for QBR or Finance review

● Review missing or incomplete agency deals, update the reconciliation file, coordinate

gaps, and preserve process notes for future cycles

● Update operational inputs that feed deal calculation, benefits application, and

downstream tracking so calculators reflect the latest agreed terms

Systems and data hygiene

● Prepare client and agency pricing-condition rows, upload or submit them in NAS / Ad

Connect, and QA that the right rates appear for the right client / agency / deal

● Update special-rate records when annual deals, client negotiations, or agency terms

require non-standard pricing, then confirm the system reflects approved terms




● Create commitment records in CRM, update required fields, and ensure AM / CP teams

can link opportunities correctly

● Review Salesforce opportunity and commitment records, update missing fields, and flag

gaps that block deal execution or reporting

● Filter uploaded conditions, compare against the source spreadsheet, and document

corrections before Sales relies on the terms

● Keep the rate card, deal directory, benefits files, package trackers, pricing-condition files,

and system records aligned

Reporting, dashboards, and visibility

● Review the LATAM revenue dashboard, Agency QBR files, One Source, and related

trackers used in approvals, reconciliation, and team updates

● Update AV usage reporting, summarize quarterly usage, and share visibility with partner

teams

● Update makegood reporting, capture approved cases, and maintain history for future

review

● Update the reporting layer used by agency teams to review rebate projections and

local-currency performance

● Use revenue, pacing, and deal trackers to surface where commitments, benefits, or

delivery require follow-up

● Connect with Finance, FPO, Revenue Accounting, SOP, Sales, and global / regional

teams when trackers, reconciliations, pricing conditions, or dashboard numbers need

validation

Finance and payment follow-through

● Update preliminary agency rebate calculation files and align numbers with FP&A, FPO,

and Revenue Accounting

● Share invoice information with agency teams, track invoice status, and confirm invoice /

payment alignment

● Update Street Media commission calculation files and keep supporting numbers

traceable

● Track signature status, update deal-close follow-through, and keep the tracker current as

deals move from negotiation to execution

● Document cases where annual targets create retroactive payment implications, update

the reconciliation file, and share the numbers




What We're Looking For

● 3+ years of experience in Revenue Management, Pricing & Planning, Advertising

Operations, and/or Advertising Strategy, ideally in media or tech




● Strong modeling skills and comfort with large datasets in Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau,

and other visualization tools

● Comfort operating across multiple systems and source files (rate cards, deal trackers,

NAS / Ad Connect, Salesforce / CRM)

● Familiarity with programmatic advertising, auction dynamics, and/or ad tech is a plus

● Knowledge of the streaming advertising and ad tech ecosystem is highly preferred

● Portuguese and English required; Spanish is a plus

● Embodies Netflix's cultural values and is excited to work in a high-performance culture

● Strong attention to detail with an 80/20 eye toward solving problems

● Proactive and independent; thrives in a fast-paced, always-changing environment

● Strong interpersonal skills and proven ability to build successful relationships with

cross-functional stakeholders

● Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to present complex analyses to

senior stakeholders

● Very strong project management, including handling multiple projects simultaneously

and delivering under tight timelines

We’re looking for an experienced salesperson to help build Univision’s new self-service advertising business in the United States.

Identify and address process gaps or errors to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.


What You'll Need


Deep expertise in restaurant technology, POS platforms, and operational best practices.
Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, engaging senior stakeholders to drive alignment.
Advanced proficiency in virtual training, remote onboarding, and implementation best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a strategic approach to complex client needs.

title: human resource specialist
description:
About the job

📢 We’re Hiring: Human Resources Specialist | Vetta Mexico

📍 Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico

Vetta Mexico is looking for a proactive Human Resources Specialist with strong English communication skills and hands-on experience in recruitment, HR audits, performance management, and compensation planning.

If you enjoy working with people, improving HR processes, and using data to support business decisions, we’d love to hear from you!

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage full-cycle recruitment, from sourcing and interviewing candidates to coordinating offers and onboarding.

• Partner with managers to identify staffing needs and attract qualified talent.

• Support internal and external HR audits, maintain accurate employee records, and follow up on corrective actions.

• Track and analyze HR KPIs, including turnover, absenteeism, time to hire, and recruitment costs.

• Support salary benchmarking, compensation reviews, and salary structures that promote fairness and market competitiveness.

• Coordinate performance reviews and help managers establish measurable employee goals.

• Support employee relations, training, and HR policy implementation.

• Coordinate with payroll and relevant teams to support compliance with Mexican labor requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of relevant HR experience.

• Strong spoken and written English—you should be comfortable participating in meetings and communicating with international colleagues.

• Professional fluency in Spanish.

• Hands-on experience in recruitment and HR audit preparation.

• Working knowledge of Mexican labor law, compensation and benefits, performance management, and HR KPIs.

• Strong Excel skills and the ability to analyze HR data.

• Excellent organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Salary based on experience and qualifications.

• Statutory benefits in Mexico, including IMSS coverage, aguinaldo, paid vacation, and vacation premium.

• Details of additional benefits and any applicable incentives will be shared during the interview process.

INTERESTED?

Please send your résumé via LinkedIn direct message, along with a brief introduction highlighting your HR experience and English proficiency.

We are a digitally native technology services company where innovation, design and engineering meet scale. We use some of the latest technologies in the digital and cognitive field to empower organizations in every aspect.

Looking for an AI Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals who has hands-on experience designing, building and deploying agentic AI systems into production.

You will work on the design and development of AI systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate, reason, use tools and interact with external systems to complete complex workflows. LLM use is required.

Abilities/skills needed:


Agentic experience
Knowledge of multi-agent frameworks and large language models (LLMs) ( ie Copilot, claude, GPT, devlin, anthropic, openAI,CodeX)
Understanding/use of prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and the failures that make agentic workflows unreliable. (ie You've built non-trivial agent systems and know where the rough edges are)
Experience with LLM tool/function calling and API integrations.
Recommend and implement architecture for model and agent pipelines, CI/CD, testing, deployment, observability, and LLMOps at scale
Build guardrails for safety, compliance, and performance monitoring including human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval workflows, escalation policies, and sandbox isolation
Performance based, must meet delivery timelines
Ship Fast, Fix Faster — The AI landscape moves daily. You iterate quickly, stay current with research and model releases, and apply what you learn to production immediately
5–10 years of software engineering experience
Modern CI/CD experience is advantageous
Strong foundation in git
Strong foundation in development, release management.
Experience in ado & github
Experience in github actions
Experience in yaml pipelines
Experience with AWS or Azure



At Globant we believe that an inclusive culture and a diverse environment makes us stronger. We encourage people to have an inclusive spirit as our global footprint expands. We seek to generate a place of inspiration and growth for everyone. A safe space, based on equity as a value, where everyone's careers can be promoted and developed in the same way. There is no innovation without diversity and there is no improvement without plurality.

Are you ready?

description:
About the job

About The Team

The Specialist, Product Management evaluates market opportunities and customer needs to shape Zillow’s product portfolio, leveraging data and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable, high-impact technology solutions. This role translates insights into clear roadmaps and requirements, guides features from concept through launch and optimization, and helps ensure products align with business objectives and a cohesive customer experience across platforms.

About The Role

Our goal is to deliver relevant ads on the best mobile digital experience in real estate. To achieve this, we are building and integrating new ad infrastructure enabling us to create and manage ads in the app. We will replicate existing web ads and create new ads that are consistent with the mobile experience. This role will lead both efforts.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


Own the end-to-end ideation, execution, evaluation, and iteration cycle of ads in the Zillow app
Be Zillow’s expert on iOS & Android app advertising trends and capabilities, and a thought leader on how to leverage these innovations into industry-leading digital ad experiences for our customers
Work across functions (engineering, data science, sales, product) to own Zillow app ad data & metrics reporting. Represent ad data trends & insights to senior leadership. 
Influence other product teams roadmaps to drive ad tests that create an excellent core ad experience. 
Work closely with a talented, highly-motivated cross-functional team, and represent app expertise to 150+ product teams within Zillow Group
Be the evangelist for your initiatives across the organization to achieve shared prioritization and execution on the most impactful work
Communicate plans, status and outcomes regularly with partners
Adapt quickly in an agile and iterative team environment


Qualifications


2+ years of proficient ability in a product management role in digital media. A focus on building ad technology products with agile product development or ad operations is preferable
Experience with building for mobile applications at scale
Prior experience with and knowledge of mobile attribution and ad performance measurement
High skill and enthusiasm for digging into quantitative and qualitative data, developing and testing hypotheses, and seeking the “why” behind data trends
Ability to clearly define product objectives, estimated impact, and success metrics that align to business strategy and product vision
Ability to work successfully with cross-functional teams (engineering, sales, data science, design) and across different product organizations
Ability to balance strategic priorities, business goals, customer needs, technical feasibility, and time to market to define impactful product solutions
Proven ability to independently establish relationships, influence others and resolve challenges with internal & external teams
Humility to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively
Very strong written communication, with an emphasis on high-quality artifacts (product briefs, strategy documents, leadership-facing presentations)
Either a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a technical/analytical field, equivalent tech work experience, or an MBA


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
skills: Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer.
Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse.
Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability.

Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number.
Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases.

Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.
Diagnose and resolve data incidents.
Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.
Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.
Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.
Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.
4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.
Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.

Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.
Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.

Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.
Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.
Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed.
Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code.
Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.).
Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact.
Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough.
Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way.
Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables.

description:
About the job

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.




We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.




Job Summary:

Toptal prides itself on being a data-driven organization. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions.




Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other.




This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. To be successful in this role you must live and breathe SQL daily and be a critical thinker, problem solver and self-starter.




This role requires an AI-heavy workflow and skillset. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward.




This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.




Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer.

Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.
Diagnose and resolve data incidents.
Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.
Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.
Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.
Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.




Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.
4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.
Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.
Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.
Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.
Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.
Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.
Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed.
Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code.
Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.).
Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact.

We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Pythian is building a next-generation Site Reliability Engineering team, and we’re looking for talented, motivated engineers who thrive in fast-paced, problem-solving environments. As an SRE, you’ll design, deploy, and operate large-scale distributed systems across compute, storage, networking, and AI/ML environments. Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.

Bachelor's degree.

Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

About the job

Company Overview

Our client builds an all-in-one booking and park-management platform for outdoor hospitality. Campground, RV park, and glamping operators use it to manage reservations, availability, rates, payments, guest messaging, and reporting in one place. It also runs a traveler-facing marketplace that brings operators more bookings.

Many customers are small and mid-sized businesses whose busiest days depend on the software running smoothly. They choose this platform for its ease of use and for the real, hands-on support behind it.

Your Role

This role exists to keep customers successful long after onboarding ends.

You'll be the go-to contact for a portfolio of parks. You'll answer questions, solve problems, and help operators use more of the platform as their business grows. Success in this role means customers feel supported, use the product confidently, and stay with the platform year after year.

You’ll:


Serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of active customers
Answer product questions and troubleshoot issues with bookings, rates, payments, and availability

description:
About the job

The mission:

We are looking for someone who will produce a measurable uplift in Baubap's acquisition and growth metrics through lifecycle management.

This role owns the communication layer of the customer lifecycle from the acquisition and growth side: from first touch and activation, through repeat usage and expansion. Unlike a traditional CRM/lifecycle role, this is not about shipping campaigns, flows or canvases — it is about connecting every lifecycle decision to a business outcome (conversion rate, new borrowers, activation rate, repeat origination, LTV) and proving, with data, what that decision was worth.

The person in this role thinks like a growth analyst first and a lifecycle operator second. They use data, experimentation and behavioral logic to decide who we talk to, with what message, through which channel, at what moment.

This is not a "send the campaign" role. It is the role that decides who we talk to, with what message, through which channel, at what moment, and then proves, with data, what that decision was worth to the business. Every communications decision needs to be provable with data — not assumed, not "it felt right." And this person doesn't run one initiative at a time: they are expected to be the owner of multiple projects in parallel, each with its own baseline, accountability, and result.

The expected outcome:

Business analysis and impact orientation


Connect every lifecycle initiative to a growth or business metric (activation, new borrowers, repeat origination, LTV) before it is designed. If an initiative cannot be tied to an outcome, it doesn't ship.
Analyze funnel and cohort data to find where the business is leaking value, and prioritize initiatives by expected economic impact, not by ease of execution.
Own the analytical read of what is working and what is not, and kill what is not — including your own initiatives.


End-to-end design and execution


Design and implement the lifecycle communication strategy end to end: journey design, copy, execution in the CRM (Braze), and coordination with paid/acquisition channels and product touchpoints where relevant.
Design, run and measure experiments (A/B tests, holdouts, sample definition, cohort comparisons) to validate what actually moves the needle, not just what looks better.
Build the channel and timing logic for acquisition/activation moments and defend it with results.


Measurement, rollout and guardrails


Every initiative starts with a baseline, an expected uplift, a defined success metric and guardrails. No initiative launches without them.
Own the full rollout: correct execution, monitoring, and attention to incidents or edge cases as they appear.
Build the dashboards needed to read your own initiatives without depending on someone else pulling the number for you.

Build standing relationships with Product, Data, Engineering and Marketing/Growth — not one-off requests, but agreed ways of working (tracking plans, review turnaround, incident response).
Be the proactive owner of your own projects: you don't wait for someone to unblock you or chase you for status. You chase dependencies, follow up, and make sure things actually happen end to end with cross-functional teams.

About the job

Ubicación idiomas y nivel

Nivel: Level Entry/Junior

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) es una empresa líder en la industria de snacks, reconocida por crear más momentos de felicidad a través de sus marcas icónicas. Con un sólido portafolio de chocolates, confitería y snacks salados, Hershey deleita a millones de consumidores cada día. Nuestras marcas incluyen Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers y muchas más.

En Hershey estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto positivo en las comunidades donde vivimos, trabajamos y hacemos negocios. Este compromiso comenzó con nuestro fundador, Milton Hershey, y continúa siendo parte fundamental de nuestra identidad.

Guiados por nuestra propuesta de valor al empleado, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, empoderamos a nuestra gente para generar impacto hoy y construir el futuro. Nuestra mentalidad One Hershey une equipos de distintas funciones, geografías y negocios para trabajar con agilidad, colaboración y un propósito compartido.

About the job

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

As an organization we are committed to developing the next generation of Makers and Bakers. Joining us at an early career stage in our fast paced and ever changing environment will enable you to do more, learn more and grow more. You will be encouraged to step outside your comfort zone– you may even surprise yourself! We will ensure you are given the support you need to be at your best and enable you to be yourself and bring passion and personality. Here you can lean in and speak up and bring your own flavor.

Formarás parte del equipo de Revenue Growth Management (RGM), apoyando el análisis y ejecución de nuestra estrategia promocional y generando insights que contribuyan a mejores decisiones de negocio.

Principales responsabilidades:


Apoyar al equipo de RGM Promo en la ejecución, seguimiento y análisis del proceso promocional.
Analizar el desempeño de promociones a través de indicadores como elasticidad, uplift, ROI e inversión promocional.
Dar seguimiento a resultados reales vs. estimados, identificando desviaciones, aprendizajes y oportunidades de mejora.
Gestionar y mantener actualizadas bases de datos de clientes, productos, precios y promociones, asegurando la calidad de la información.
Elaborar cierres mensuales, reportes y análisis de desempeño por categoría.
Dar seguimiento a la correcta implementación de precios y promociones aprobadas.
Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones del equipo de RGM.
Participar en proyectos de mejora continua y optimización de la estrategia promocional.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas del negocio para desarrollar una visión integral de cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan el crecimiento y la rentabilidad.



¿Qué buscamos?


Estudiantes de últimos semestres de Economía, Actuaría, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas, Business Analytics, Administración o carreras afines, con interés en desarrollar una carrera en áreas comerciales y analíticas.
Perfil analítico y numérico, con capacidad para trabajar con información, identificar tendencias y generar conclusiones.
Manejo de Excel intermedio-avanzado.
Inglés intermedio-avanzado.
Pensamiento estructurado, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
Curiosidad por entender el negocio y cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan las ventas y rentabilidad.
Capacidad de aprendizaje, iniciativa y disposición para trabajar de manera colaborativa.



Será un plus contar con conocimientos de Power BI, SQL, herramientas de visualización de datos o estadística aplicada.

No es necesario contar con experiencia previa en RGM: buscamos personas con potencial, curiosidad y ganas de desarrollar habilidades analíticas y comerciales.

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident, Oreo, Philadelphia, and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo. We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. We are also home to one of the 11 technology centers Mondelez International has worldwide, a specialized gum and candy facility that places us at the forefront of innovation and development in the country and drives our purpose to lead the future of snacking. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. We are constantly working on extending the product suite with new features and improvements.

The opportunity


Own the connective tissue between marketing and product at Kraken Consumer — a remit with real scope to shape how millions of people discover and return to our products.
Build something from the ground up: the roadmap, the intake model and the standards for how marketing and product work together are all yours to define.
Sit at the centre of the acquisition funnel, where small improvements in conversion compound into meaningful growth.
Unlock new acquisition channels by building the product surfaces they depend on — paid social, search, affiliates and offline campaigns.
Shape a fast-growing mobile acquisition motion, including in-product social, creator partnerships, community and friend-referral mechanics.
Own both halves of the lifecycle: bringing new users in, and giving existing users compelling reasons to come back.
Work in one of the most competitive corners of consumer fintech, where conversion craft and product quality genuinely decide who wins.


What You Bring


Own the marketing product roadmap end to end, and build the process that turns campaign ideas into shipped product work.
Design and launch tailored campaign experiences — the in-app and web journeys users land in from push, email, social and paid.
Raise the bar on lifecycle messaging so push and email feel useful rather than noisy, and convert accordingly.
Own the incentives layer for new and returning users: offers, referral mechanics, recurring deposits and earn-led campaigns.
Apply user psychology and sharp UX thinking to find where the funnel leaks, then run the experiments that close the gaps.
Improve landing page and search performance, and build the product foundations that make paid and offline channels measurable and worth the spend.
Partner with marketing, design, engineering and data as the single point of ownership for growth enablement.
Define the acquisition and reactivation metrics that matter, and report on them honestly — including when an experiment doesn't land.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

description:
About the job

About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger state. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

About The Role

This role ensures OAF Nigeria's expansion and business innovation agenda delivers on its 2030 ambition by identifying and validating new geographies and revenue opportunities, leading the end-to-end entry of new states from scouting through to operational handover, and building the commercial models that make each new market financially sustainable from day one.

Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Innovation


You will design OAF Nigeria's 5-year expansion and business innovation strategy, identifying new geographies, new revenue streams, and new commercial models that reduce dependence on any single income line and support the path to financial sustainability.
You will drive from strategy to a concrete annual plan — translating the long-term ambition into sequenced state entries, product and service trials, and business model validations with clear timelines and owners.


Expansion Execution


You will lead the end-to-end entry of new states — from security risk assessment and field scouting through site setup, stakeholder engagement, first-season farmer enrollment, and handover to the Regional Lead.
You will manage the expansion operations calendar, aligning scouting, SRA, state confirmation, infrastructure setup, and planting season windows so that no gate is missed and no entry is made without validated evidence.


People Management and Coaching


You will manage a team of four permanent staff, ensuring each person has clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path.
You will be a senior leader within the Programs Division, providing cross-departmental support through coaching and mentoring of mid-level staff, and helping to build the next generation of State Operations Leads and Regional Leads from within the expansion team.


Monitoring and Reporting


You will develop and track KPIs across all active expansion states and business innovation trials — including farmer enrollment rates, first-season repayment performance, gross margin per farmer, revenue per trial state, and new product uptake against target.
You will produce timely, actionable reports and communicate risks, progress, and go/no-go recommendations to the Head of Programs, Country Director, and Steerco — with the clarity and data quality expected of someone operating at the interface between field execution and organisational strategy.


Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

We seek a professional with over 7 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years leading cross-functional teams and working across multiple departments, combined with a passion for building commercially sustainable agricultural programmes that serve smallholder farmers.


Strategic thinking: Ability to translate a long-term ambition into a sequenced, evidence-based growth plan
Commercial acumen: Experience identifying, designing, and validating new revenue opportunities — products, services, or business models — in complex or resource-constrained environments
Project management: Ability to design, plan, and run multiple complex projects simultaneously to successful outcomes
Growth mindset: Enthusiasm for learning, feedback, and continuous improvement in the face of ambiguity
Results-oriented: You set goals, take ownership, and hold yourself and your team accountable for delivering them
Cross-functional fluency: You collaborate effectively with colleagues across programmes, finance, operations, and external partners
Strong educational background; minimum Bachelor's Degree, postgraduate qualification preferred
Willingness to be based in Minna, Niger State, with significant field travel across expansion states for periods of up to 18 months per assignment
English required; Hausa speaking strongly preferred


Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Minna, Niger State, Nigeria - Onsite

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

Application Deadline

16th October, 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
